newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND STEADY AGAINST DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND STEADY AGAINST DOLLAR.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was stable against the dollar on Wednesday in a private sector market short of the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is still short in dollars. There is some supply and demand but dollars are generally not available," said one.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3900 and 3.3960 pounds bid and 3.3910 and 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was stable at 3.3935 bid and 3.3950 offered, the same rates offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average rate at midday as 3.388239 pounds buy and 3.395941 pounds sell.
